newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian 91-day treasury bill cut-off unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian 91-day treasury bill cut-off unchanged.

text.p: The Reserve BAnk of India said on Friday it set a cut-off price of 97.57 rupees at the weekly auction of 91-day treasury bills, unchanged from the last auction.
Dealers said the yield was steady at 9.99 percent.
The RBI said it received 35 competitive bids for 6.38 billion rupees and two non-competitive bids for 6.5 billion.
Twenty-two competitive bidders were allotted treasury bills in full and six received partial allotment for a total of 4.34 billion rupees, it said.
The two non-competitive bidders received partial allotment for the balance 656 million rupees, the RBI said.
The weighted average price for the auction was 97.61 rupee, it said.
